claim: On breast_cancer's declared 5-fold split (569 rows, every row held out exactly once; majority 0.6316, fold-mean resolution 0.18 pp), local_goodness with its declared target channel (credit.readout_error=True) and gradient are equivalent within a +/-0.01 fold-mean val_acc margin at L2/20 on the same digital/feedforward/instantaneous/null/adam cell, paired over fresh seeds 72-76
protocol: TODO92 section 3.8 follow-up (a): convert the post-hoc tabular parity into a pre-registered equivalence claim. Screening input: the section 3.8 superiority run measured paired +0.0003, 95% CI [-0.0025, +0.0025] over seeds 67-71 on this ruler, and FAILED its +0.005 threshold, so the +1.58 pp section 3.13 advantage is retracted. That parity reading was post-hoc on this ruler; the vision arm of the same credit is already a pre-registered equivalence claim (configs/preregistrations/t92_local_goodness_gradient.json, seed 1 preceded by commit 3b9308d2). This file fixes the plan's standard +/-0.01 margin before seed 1 of the tabular equivalence run, so the two-family weak-thesis statement becomes claim-grade on both families instead of one registered claim plus one post-hoc coordinate. Instrument: scripts/probes/t92_local_goodness_tabular_folds.py, unchanged ruler and eval site (TabularTask.fold_indices(5), stratified, random_state=0, all 569 rows held out exactly once, fold-mean 0.18 pp resolution, score = trainer's last-epoch val_acc as a corpus cell reads it). Arms: control = credit gradient; treatment = credit local_goodness + credit.readout_error=True; reference stack digital/feedforward/instantaneous/null/adam, geometry.hidden_dim=256, 74,242 params both arms; L2/20, CPU. Seeds 72-76 are fresh at this schedule and fold ruler (pilot seed 42, one epoch, excluded). Decision: the 95% bootstrap CI of the paired per-seed fold-mean difference lies inside [-0.01, +0.01] (computronium.validation.preregistration.PairedComparison.passes_equivalence). Error costs: a false EQUIVALENT keeps a parity credit alive on two families and licenses one more map row; a false NOT-EQUIVALENT retires a credit that may hold parity, which the plan answers by re-running the same cell, never by tuning. Stop rule: if the CI leaves the margin, report the measured boundary and do not tune lr, do not add seeds, do not switch tasks; the stop-loss disposition is then rewritten from the measured map.
